name: rental_property_annual_cash_roi
question_template: A rental property is bought outright for USD {PRICE} with no financing. It earns monthly rent of USD {RENT} for all 12 months of the year and incurs annual operating expenses of USD {EXPENSES} for taxes, insurance and maintenance. Assume no vacancy and ignore any price appreciation. Compute annual net operating income = 12 x monthly rent - annual expenses, then the annual cash ROI = net operating income / purchase price x 100 percent. Use exact arithmetic.

slots.description: Total rent collected over twelve months.
Annual rent less annual operating expenses.

program:
def solve():
    price = Q(P["PRICE"])
    rent = Q(P["RENT"])
    expenses = Q(P["EXPENSES"])
    gross_rent = 12 * rent
    noi = gross_rent - expenses
    roi = noi / price * 100
    return {"final": roi, "annual_gross_rent_trace": gross_rent, "net_operating_income_trace": noi}
